title: 911 Carrera S at a Late-Night Gas Station
label: RAIN + LO-FI
description:
A electric blue Porsche 911 Carrera S at a late-night gas station: light rain at an empty gas station at 2 am. Eight hours of steady white noise with a slow, original lo-fi track drifting in now and then, for sleeping, studying, or winding down after a long day in the bay.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original to this channel.

Built for mechanics, car people, and anyone who sleeps better with a little noise.

Made by a mobile ADAS calibration tech. Absolute ADAS: https://absoluteadas.com
